name: caddy-mcp
description: Your company's knowledge graph, answerable inside Claude. Portal login, graph delivery and refresh, live knowledge writes, account maps, and packages.
long_description: Caddy connects Claude to your organization's own knowledge graph. Log in once with a device code, pull the company graph your team's Caddy portal generated, and every answer is grounded in your business's actual data, on your machine. Graph data stays local: the portal streams it here and keeps no copy. Includes live knowledge writes with provenance, per-platform account maps, Notion workspace graphs, and one-click install of the packages your seat is entitled to.
